purpose: Handles complaint center: get all, complaintscms approval, complaintscms reject, factory visit, factory remarks, complaint closure revoke and 4 more

menu_permission.permission_format: {module_code}/{section-slug}/{sub-section-slug}:{flag}; flag is a UserRoleDetailed column (view, add, edit, delete, approve, reject, remarks, close)

endpoints.name: Get All
endpoints.detailed_description: Retrieve all complaint center records. It calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IIndent.BuildFilterContext, IComplaintCenter.GetComplaintCenterData. Data access uses stored procedure(s): GetComplaintCenter. Possible responses: 200, 401, 500.

error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Invalid token or user not found [when currentUser == null]
error_handling.exceptions: Caught and returned as 500 with the exception message (catches: Exception)

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to retrieve all complaint center records
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to change data

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieve all complaint center records — calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IIndent.BuildFilterContext, IComplaintCenter.GetComplaintCenterData
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Invalid token or user not found
